run_fields.adopted_candidates: adopted=True decisions; branch retention need not change champion
run_fields.final_test: aggregates from that exact checkpoint only

curve_fields.training.mean: native average reward; success rate for binary environments
curve_fields.validation: original decision field; may be mean or strict depending on variant
curve_fields.planned_target_repairs: repairs in diagnosed clusters assigned to an edited plugin; null without a target record
curve_fields.batch: rotating training batch index or null
curve_fields.runtime_evidence: reported per-plugin loads, hook events, input matches and runner controls, not causal attribution

final_test_fields.strict_repeat_population_std: population standard deviation of observed repeat strict-success rates
final_test_fields.observed_any_success_3: per-task success in at least one of three observed trials
final_test_fields.observed_all_success_3: per-task success in all three observed trials
final_test_fields.runtime.elapsed_seconds.sum: sum of valid episode elapsed seconds; not experiment wall time

scope: Historical and new feedback data use heterogeneous protocols; joining rows does not make a controlled comparison.
